status: Design targets; not measured performance or observed traffic

units.screen_size: CSS-equivalent pixels at 390 px viewport width; native pixels divided by viewport scale

style.name: Style B — real proportions, simplified surfaces, soft light
style.color_space: sRGB authoring; interpolate in linear light
style.lighting: Inherit approved shared mid-afternoon review light for calibration; actual environment.json solar/weather/time overrides review fixture.

anchor.approvedFileIdentity: UNRESOLVED: no unambiguous approval/file mapping found; clarification requested
anchor.instructionPriority: User's explicit blue-sky mid-afternoon description and Denver balance take precedence over contradictory file numbering

sky.interpolation: Linear RGB; elevation above world horizon, not screen height
sky.cloudPolicy: One clear partly cloudy preset; projected clouds differ with camera direction, not per-view color grades

sun.fixturePolicy: One illustrative art-review fixture in world coordinates. No timestamp/location or camera headings have been validated from images. Production live/recap solar model overrides fixture elevation/azimuth; never falsify real weather/time to enforce hero lighting.
sun.fillCalibration: On the same neutral diagnostic plane, normalized lit contributions are direct=.38 and diffuse fill=.62, giving shadow/lit=.62 before AO. These are contribution ratios, not renderer-specific environment intensity units. Calibrate against E0; directIntensityRelativeClearE0=1 retains the clear-state sun scale.

shadows.tintRole: Cool-neutral gray-blue appearance cue, not a purple overlay on every surface or a replacement albedo
shadows.softEdgePolicy: Existing filtered directional shadows with moderate penumbra; preserve dark geometric recesses. No additional shadow map/light/pass.
shadows.occlusionMerge: min(existingVisibility,newVisibility); don't multiply repeated contact AO

exposure.reference: Frozen clear-day E0 from existing paintover-v1 ordinary-street, not absolute camera EV/lux
exposure.toneMapPolicy: Use one renderer tone mapper/white balance across views. Warm sun is lighting; no extra yellow/sepia post-grade.

ground.colorRole: Dry neutral reference/base swatches, not fixed lit/shadow pixels

trees.positionPolicy: Keep existing trunk bases and approximate crown envelopes

dressing.placement: Illustrative inferred curbside dressing; road-side of curb only, clear sidewalks and drive accesses
dressing.lamps: A few generic unlit posts in parkway; no extra daytime lights
dressing.treePits: Small earth/mulch pits at existing parkway trunks only; not authorization to move trees or pave lawns

compatibility.conflict: Per-frame grades vary: ordinary +.35 EV vs Lakeview +.20 EV and golden palettes. New shared hero block supersedes those per-frame day grades for these four references only.
compatibility.resolution: Use ordinary +.35 EV/1.06 contrast/1.08 saturation once; remove old warmth grade (4%) because warm light tint now supplies warmth. Preserve houseTypes values.

compatibility.conflict: Ordinary 15:30 uses +.10 EV and #99AFE0 fill. Hero uses +.35 EV referenced to paintover-v1 E0 and neutralized #AEBCCA fill; no renderer equivalence proven. The old 2.2 key:fill witness ratio also conflicts with a .62 shadow/lit witness ratio if both mean contributions on the same plane.
compatibility.resolution: This is an explicitly versioned hero review preset, not a silent rewrite of time-of-day keys. Calibrate E0 and witness patch before adopting in engine. For the shared hero witness use direct .38 / fill .62, hence key:fill .612903. Do not also apply the legacy 2.2 contribution ratio.

compatibility.conflict: Hero dry ground/wetness=0 is inapplicable to rain. Rain's per-surface darkening and roughness changes must not be stacked with another wetness policy.
compatibility.resolution: Keep dry palette as base. When rain active, rain-v1 materialFormula overrides dry roughness; apply its single darkening multiplier (max12%) once, then weather-state light/sky override hero clear sun.

compatibility.conflict: Hero directSun=1/blue sky/+.35 EV cannot coexist with blue-hour directSun=0/+ .20EV, night directSun=0/+ .35EV or morning-fog reduced direct sun/optical depth.
compatibility.resolution: Hero is one clear daytime state only. At night/blue-hour/fog use named state lighting, exposure and atmosphere as replacements, not summed EV or hero sun beneath fog/night. House geometry/base palette remains shared.

compatibility.conflict: Earlier validation said source lighting direction remained close. This revision intentionally changes lighting, ground color balance and postcard vegetation/dressing.
compatibility.resolution: Supersede earlier validation for new hero files; originals remain intact. Generated shadow bearings and exact hex pixels are illustrative, not measured.

style.proportion_policy: Real body/cabin/wheelbase/wing/hull/head-limb ratios; no toy/chibi/chunky exaggeration; simplify surface detail not scale.
style.surface_policy: Smooth matte surfaces, restrained broad geometry and opaque glass; no photographic textures, dense surface pattern or toy faceting.

near.features: Silhouette, bevels, wheels/limbs, up to2 large accent patches; no badges/handles/faces

mid.features: Body plus cabin/limb silhouette; merge tiny pieces; no wheel spokes or face detail

far.features: Single/simple colored silhouette, no small openings; no mesh upscaling

subpixel.action: Cull optional life; preserve required tracked entities via separate map/UI representation, not fake oversized world meshes

people_distance_examples_m.note: Illustrative only; projected size wins. Wheels, wing span and hull length use longest projected dimension; people use height.

shared_effects.note: Competing caps, not additive entitlements. Rain/snow/leaves share existing0.20ms weather bucket; all effects alpha area includes overlaps summed against screen area.

parked_road_max.note: Not additional triangle allowance. Count opaque geometry and submissions against same scene ceilings.

budget.note: Ambient targets replace headroom inside existing buckets; do not add0.35ms on top. All timings are hypotheses until ten-minute sustained device benchmark.

simulation.stable_seed: Use existing StableRandom/OSMRef + semantic salt; never per-frame randomness
simulation.speed_rule: Use verified live speed/route when available; generic ranges below are art priors, not legal limits
simulation.spawn_rule: Mapped navigable roads, footways, rail and water; respect lane direction/left-driving regional data, turn restrictions and accessible paths; never simulate known closures or private interiors
simulation.shelter_rule: Suppress splashes/sprinklers under known cover; reduce pedestrians in hazardous weather; never infer evacuation crowds
simulation.lifecycle: Fade optional population at spawn/despawn boundaries outside foreground; keep identity stable; no teleporting on camera motion
simulation.missing_live: Show ambient_synthetic label in accessible info; no implied exact private activity
simulation.emergency: Parked or rare slow-moving generic emergency vehicles only without entitled incident data; no invented emergency dispatch, flashing alarm or siren

effects.rule: Only eligible high-altitude flight and weather support; unknown defaults off. Screen-size cap and no weather forecast claim.
Hard wet surface only; small expanding procedural ring+1–2droplets; no black stain. Budget prioritizes visible falling rain.
Requires loose snow+wind; low sparse ribbons; never automatic drifting/plowing history.
Opaque simple2–6triangle leaves; deciduous leaf-fall season+wind; bounded near camera.
Known vent or explicitly synthetic decorative location; pale vertical puffs drift with wind; no fire/smoke claim.
Only existing plausible chimney; synthetic activity explicitly marked; not every house, never wildfire tint.
Optional synthetic sprinkler on eligible lawn; dry mild day only, off rain/freeze/drought restriction or unknown policy; no real household schedule claim.

shadow_policy.animals: Optional cheap contact treatment only inside existing shadow/contact bucket
shadow_policy.lights: Emergency housings nonflashing; global maximum2nearby unshadowed lights shared by entire scene

realism_anchor_policy.rule: Match Japan regional kit proportions, smooth matte surface simplification and detail restraint; adapt real class dimensions and silhouettes to local US forms. Boats inherit the same treatment; the Japan kit contains no boat-specific sheet.
realism_anchor_policy.regional_adaptation: US roads: right-hand traffic, normally left-hand driver position and passenger boarding on the curb/right side. Japan roads: left-hand traffic and appropriate local placement. Rail running direction, platforms and vessel operations follow local/source data; never infer them by mirroring road traffic.
realism_anchor_policy.preserve: Existing ambient tiers, palettes, dimensions and density budgets remain unchanged; Japan sheet thresholds do not replace ambient thresholds.
realism_anchor_policy.art_status: Existing US sheets are supporting concepts; this transport anchor takes precedence wherever their surface detail differs.
